raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Caligula Wikipedia page and stated that Caligula’s mother was Agrippina the Younger, when the page clearly identifies his mother as Agrippina the Elder (Vipsania Agrippina). This confusion between similarly named figures (Elder vs. Younger) constitutes a genealogical misidentification and would lead to the wrong mother-in-law for Lollia Paulina if propagated.
